direction: Original high-resolution retro space-opera illustration, tactile worn materials, deep navy/mineral teal shadows and warm amber light, readable alien silhouettes; no text, logos or watermark.

assets.brief: Chmmr envoy, cyan crystalline core joined to bronze articulated lattice, complementary light rhythms, no humanoid face; cooperation without erased difference.
Elderly Ur-Quan keeper, suspended green segmented body, small violet eyes, scarred mandibles and tendrils, holding an unmarked memorial token in an archive.
Newly born Afterlight person, amber and violet filaments making an incomplete open hand inside a rescued transmitter, one strand examining a screw.
Human expedition engineer, short dark curls with silver temples, navy patched work jacket, solder lamp, repaired cup; warmth and practical competence.
Supox botanist, rust-red and green leaves, expressive seedpod eyes, root tendrils, grafting tools, humid shipboard greenhouse; entirely botanical anatomy.
Votir acoustic architect, asymmetric ivory ceramic shells, indigo tissue, tiny amber eyes, bronze resonant rings, one carefully repaired crack.
Yehat convoy commander, long ochre beak, swept crest, folded wing-arms, repaired navy/bronze harness, navigation astrolabe and emergency blankets.
Silver-haired human reconstruction architect, ivory uniform, repaired wrist brace, relief charts and one living plant; compassionate, controlled, tired.
Afterlight dissenter, white-blue angular light threads and violet prisms in an asymmetrical torn sail, parallel strands, one tiny amber reaching filament.
Anxious Spathi risk assessor, one large eye on a curved stalk, sea-green asymmetric body, pink carapace, tiny colored flags and a passenger emergency kit.

A rugged survey ship approaches a liberated ocean world. Its amber shield is separating like a chrysalis; repair crews and civilian ships work below. Uneasy hope and a subtle distant beacon, dark left space for the title.
